name: Legal Pro
description: Deep navy + restrained gold authority palette for legal, regulatory, and compliance verticals.

source.note: tokens.css and components.css in this directory are verified canonical extracts. The live service file remains the single source of truth for the running application.

reuse_guide.next_vertical_pattern: Create presets/themes/<slug>/tokens.css with own --<prefix>-* raws. Override --color-primary and --color-badge-* semantic tokens. components.css reuses without modification.
reuse_guide.finance_vertical: Use --fin-* prefix, override primary to deep teal or burgundy.

wcag_aa_pairs.note: precedent badge — gold on gold-tint (est. >4.5:1, verify with WebAIM)

a11y.notes: Gold badge contrast borderline. If #B8960C on #FDF8E7 fails 4.5:1 in production measurement, replace with #92720A per D3 §2-3.
